translations.Xarita uchun uch ustun ishlating: ayblov: Use three columns in the map: prosecution explanation, defence explanation, and the examination needed to distinguish them. Read limitations in an expert opinion as part of its findings. The existence of a transfer may not, by itself, fully explain the money’s legal purpose.
translations.Shubhani yashirmang, lekin har bir noani: Do not conceal doubt, but do not declare every uncertainty a final conclusion of acquittal either. The conclusion must reflect the evidence as a whole. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Himoya nutqi va oxirgi so‘z: Defence address and the defendant’s final statement
translations.JPK 449-moddasi taraflar muzokarasi, 450: Article 449 of the Criminal Procedure Code concerns the parties’ closing arguments, Article 450 submissions on the substance of the charge, and Article 451 the defendant’s final statement. Defence counsel’s address does not replace the defendant’s final statement. The procedure and time limit for reviewing a judicial act must be determined separately by case type and procedural stage.
translations.Nutqdagi har muhim da’voni dalil identif: Check each important assertion in the address against an evidence identifier. When considering later review of a judicial act, distinguish dissatisfaction from a specific procedural or legal ground; check the procedure and time limit separately. “The decision is unfair” must be supplemented by identifying which conclusion is inconsistent with which evidence or rule.
translations.Matn uzunligi yoki ta’sirchan ovoz asos: Length or a powerful voice cannot replace reasons. Do not add a rule or figure absent from the case material to the address. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JK 168-moddasi aldash yoki ishonchni sui: Article 168 of the Criminal Code concerns obtaining another person’s property or a right to it through deception or abuse of trust. Non-performance of a contract or delayed payment does not itself prove every element of an offence. Material concerning intent, conduct and the means of obtaining property is examined separately.
translations.JK 168-moddasi va ishning protsessual ma: Article 168 of the Criminal Code and the procedural sources for the case are considered together. Material concerning the contract, movement of funds and intent is analysed within its respective limits. A payment dispute does not remove the need to examine the elements of an offence separately.
translations.Pul kechikkanini avtomatik firibgarlik y: Do not treat delayed payment as automatically establishing fraud or automatically warranting acquittal. Give independent reasons for each important element and alternative explanation. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Sudlar haqidagi qonunning 1-moddasi sud: Article 1 of the Law on Courts establishes judicial authority and the administration of justice exclusively by courts; Article 9 establishes judicial independence. The same independence is guaranteed by Article 136 of the Constitution. A judge’s task is not to arrange a victory for either party.
translations.O‘quv mashqida «sudya hal qiladi», «tara: The learning exercise uses the categories “the judge decides”, “a party submits” and “clarification needed”. A judge does not act as an adviser arranging one party’s victory. A message saying “the manager wants it this way” is neither evidence in the case nor a legal basis for a decision.
translations.Tashqi tavsiya yoki mansab egasining xoh: Outside advice or an official’s wishes cannot replace a legal basis. Do not confuse who requested a decision with the material that supports it. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Teng huquqlilik va eshitilish: Equal rights and the opportunity to be heard
translations.FPK 8 va 10-moddalari qonun va sud oldid: Articles 8 and 10 of the Civil Procedure Code concern equality before the law and courts and adversarial proceedings with equal rights for the parties. Article 11 governs the language of proceedings, and Articles 40 and 44 establish the procedural rights of participants and parties. Equal opportunity does not mean equally reliable evidence or an exactly equal number of seconds for each party.
translations.Har bir tarafga materialga munosabat bil: Plan an opportunity for each party to respond to the material and state their position. Treat barriers involving language or understanding as procedural issues too. Showing a document during a hearing does not automatically provide an opportunity to inspect a copy and respond.
translations.Teng imkoniyat ikki tarafning dalili alb: Equal opportunity does not mean the parties’ evidence necessarily carries equal weight. Allocate turns and assess evidence as separate tasks. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Fuqarolik majlisining asosiy ketma-ketli: Basic sequence of a civil hearing
translations.FPK 210-moddasi majlisni ochish, 213-mod: Article 210 of the Civil Procedure Code concerns opening the hearing, Article 213 checking attendance, Article 215 removing witnesses, and Articles 216–217 the court’s composition, challenges and explanation of rights. Explanations, examination of evidence, closing arguments and decision follow. The defendant’s final statement in criminal proceedings is not transferred to civil proceedings as a mandatory stage.
translations.Bosqichni almashtirishdan avval kerakli: Before changing stages, check that the necessary conditions have been met. Receiving a document, examining it and assessing it are presented as three separate learning actions. A submitted document does not yet have the same status as an examined document.
translations.Jinoyat ishiga xos sudlanuvchining oxirg: Do not add the defendant’s final statement, which belongs to criminal proceedings, as a mandatory stage in a civil case. The two procedures need separate routes. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.FPK 80-moddasi alohida dalilning aloqado: Article 80 of the Civil Procedure Code provides for assessment of the relevance, admissibility and reliability of individual evidence and the sufficiency of the evidence as a whole. Article 87 concerns production of the original of written evidence. A document cannot be given predetermined absolute weight without considering the difference between an original and a copy.
translations.Har muhim xulosa uchun asos bo‘lgan mate: For each important conclusion, mark the supporting material, opposing material and limitation in the table. Assess the need to examine a discrepancy between a copy and the original. If two receipts with the same title have different dates, the conflict between copies must not be ignored in the reasons for the decision.
translations.Bir hujjatga oldindan mutlaq ustunlik be: Do not give a document predetermined absolute priority. The existence of payment, the terms of an obligation and its performance may be separate issues. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Qarzning mavjudligi va qoldig‘i: Existence and outstanding balance of a debt
translations.FK 732–735-moddalari qarz shartnomasi, u: Articles 732–735 of the Civil Code regulate loan agreements, their form, interest and the obligation to repay the loan amount. Examine the purpose of the transfer, repayment terms and whether payments relate to the obligation in dispute. Establish the legal basis of the debt and payments before calculating the outstanding balance.
translations.FKning qarzga oid qoidalarini FPKdagi is: Read the Civil Code’s loan provisions together with the Civil Procedure Code’s rules on proof and drafting decisions. The reasons and outcome in the learning decision must match. A partial payment neither automatically defeats the entire claim nor permits that payment to be ignored.
translations.Da’vo qilingan summani avtomatik ko‘chir: Do not automatically copy the amount claimed. If partial payment is established, check whether it relates to this particular obligation. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.FPK 201–205-moddalari ishni sud muhokama: Articles 201–205 of the Civil Procedure Code concern the tasks and time limits for preparing a case for trial, clarification involving the parties, and the judge’s preparatory actions. Identifying disputed circumstances and necessary material does not announce the eventual outcome in advance. Plan impartially what needs clarification from each party.
translations.Taalluqlilik, ishtirokchilar va zarur ma: Check jurisdiction, participants and necessary material, and identify the questions each party needs to answer. Do not turn the court’s clarification role into advice for one party. If days worked are disputed, the preparation plan provides for comparison of attendance and payment records.
translations.Ishni ko‘rishga tayyorlash yakuniy natij: Preparing a case for a hearing does not predict the final outcome. Distinguish “to be examined” from “proved” even at the planning stage. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.FPK 219-moddasiga ko‘ra yangi dalil tala: Under Article 219 of the Civil Procedure Code, motions to obtain new evidence and other motions concerning the hearing are decided by court ruling after other participants’ views have been heard. The reason for the request and the measure sought must be clear. Granting one motion does not automatically determine the case’s final outcome.
translations.Fuqarolik ishida hujjat talab qilish, gu: In a civil case, assess requests for documents, witness summonses or hearing arrangements separately. For each, record the rule, fact and procedural outcome. Explain the need to summon a witness by identifying the important circumstance about which they can provide information.
translations.Dalilni qabul qilish haqidagi qaror butu: A decision to receive evidence does not decide in advance which party will ultimately prevail. A ready-made “granted/denied” label cannot replace reasons. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.FPKning raqamli dalillarga oid 89¹–89⁴-m: Articles 89¹–89⁴ of the Civil Procedure Code on digital evidence provide a legal basis for examining material in the appropriate form and manner; Article 80 sets out the general assessment rule. If a witness’s memory differs from a digital record, examine source, context and integrity. The discrepancy alone does not automatically prove that the witness lied.
translations.Elektron ma’lumot hamda raqamli dalilga: Read the rules on electronic information and digital evidence, and ask questions about source, integrity and context. Distinguish the event witnessed from the witness’s source for its time. Whether a device’s clock might be wrong is a question to examine, not a ready-made conclusion.
translations.Raqamli yozuvni avtomatik xatosiz yoki g: Do not automatically treat a digital record as error-free or a witness as a liar. Record an unresolved discrepancy as a limitation of the conclusion. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.FPK 253-moddasiga ko‘ra hal qiluv qarori: Under Article 253 of the Civil Procedure Code, a judgment consists of introductory, descriptive, reasoning and operative parts. The reasoning sets out the established circumstances, evidence, and substantive and procedural rules applied. The operative part states the outcome of each claim, costs, and the procedure and time limit for appeal in accordance with the applicable law.
translations.Loyihani talablar ro‘yxati bilan solisht: Compare the draft with the list of claims: is each claim addressed, are reasons given for accepting or rejecting evidence, and does the operative part match the reasoning? If the reasoning provides for partial relief but the operative part still grants full relief, the draft must be corrected.
translations.Qonun nomini ko‘p marta yozish qo‘llash: Repeatedly naming a law cannot replace explaining its application. Leaving facts from another case in a template also undermines the quality of the decision. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.MK 253-moddasi ish haqini to‘lash muddat: Article 253 of the Labour Code concerns wage payment deadlines, while Article 254 concerns settlement deadlines when an employment contract ends. These are different situations. The outstanding debt cannot be established without linking the amount accrued, amount paid and relevant period to reliable material.
translations.Mehnat kodeksining ish haqi va yakuniy h: Read the Labour Code provisions on wages and final settlement as applicable on the relevant date. A calculation table matters, but its input data must also be proved. Material must establish whether money in a bank statement is specifically wages or another payment.
translations.Qonuniy muddat yoki kompensatsiyani taxm: Do not calculate a statutory time limit or compensation from an estimated figure. The learning case must provide the necessary figures precisely or require further clarification. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Konstitutsiyaning 26–29-moddalaridagi qa: The guarantees of dignity, liberty, the presumption of innocence and qualified legal assistance in Articles 26–29 of the Constitution apply together. Article 28 establishes that there is no duty to prove one’s innocence and provides the right to remain silent. Silence is not used as evidence of guilt.
translations.Vaqt chizig‘ida erkinlik cheklanishi, hu: Mark on the timeline where restriction of liberty, explanation of rights, defence counsel and interpreter issues arose. Assess the consequences of each violation under the applicable rule. Requesting defence counsel and their actual participation are not the same fact.
Do not use silence as proof of guilt. Link an alleged violation to evidence rather than accepting or rejecting it without examination. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 95¹-moddasi dalillarning maqbul emas: Article 95¹ of the Criminal Procedure Code concerns inadmissibility of evidence, and Article 405¹¹ concerns motions to exclude inadmissible evidence. Examine which material was obtained, under what circumstances, and the parties’ arguments. Excluding one item of evidence does not remove the need to assess the remaining material separately.
translations.JPK 95¹-moddasi va Plenum tushuntirishla: Using Article 95¹ of the Criminal Procedure Code and the Plenum’s explanations, record the parties’ arguments, examined circumstances and chosen measure. Then separately consider how the remaining evidence is to be assessed. A problem with one copy does not determine the fate of another independent source without reasons.
translations.Bitta dalilning chiqarilishi barcha bosh: Excluding one item of evidence does not automatically invalidate all other material. Nor should all defects be dismissed as “insignificant” in a single sentence. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Shubha va hukm asoslari: Doubt and grounds for a criminal judgment
translations.JPK 23-moddasi aybsizlik prezumpsiyasini: Article 23 of the Criminal Procedure Code establishes the presumption of innocence, and Article 463 provides that a conviction must not be based on assumptions. Article 464 separately specifies grounds for acquittal. Doubts about guilt that remain after opportunities to resolve them have been exhausted are resolved in the person’s favour; the significance of each minor discrepancy is assessed in the context of the case.
translations.Ikki raqib tushuntirish uchun tasdiqlovc: Map the supporting and refuting material for two competing explanations. Assess the remaining discrepancy’s significance for the case against the Constitution and Criminal Procedure Code. If a discrepancy in a record concerns the person’s participation in the incident, explain its substance in the reasons for the decision.
translations.Har bir mayda tafovutni hal qiluvchi shu: Do not call every minor discrepancy a decisive doubt; do not cover a significant doubt with eloquent speech. The learning answer must explain its substance and consequences. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Hukmning asoslarini tekshirish: Reviewing the grounds for a criminal judgment
translations.JPK 455-moddasiga ko‘ra hukm qonuniy, as: Under Article 455 of the Criminal Procedure Code, a judgment must be lawful, substantiated and fair. Article 457 lists the issues to be resolved when delivering judgment, and Articles 463–464 specify grounds for conviction and acquittal. Merely listing evidence does not replace giving reasons for accepting or rejecting it.
translations.Loyihadagi har muhim xulosani tekshirilg: Link each important conclusion in the draft to examined material. Check the parties’ closing arguments, the defendant’s final statement and the decision-making procedure against criminal procedure requirements. “The evidence as a whole confirms this” is insufficient without explaining how the evidence connects.
translations.Hukm matnida dalilni faqat sanash yetarl: Merely listing evidence in a judgment is insufficient. Explain why contrary information was accepted or rejected as well; do not expand the scope of the charge without reasons. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Avval JPK 51-moddasi bo‘yicha himoyachi: First examine whether defence counsel’s participation was mandatory under Article 51 of the Criminal Procedure Code and whether the evidence is admissible under Article 95¹. Then assess the remaining material independently; Article 112 requires a confession to be corroborated by other evidence considered as a whole. Excluding one statement cannot be treated as a ready-made acquittal for the entire case.
translations.Har ikkala tarafga vaj bildirish imkonin: Allow both parties to present arguments and resolve the procedural issue with reasons. Then link all important circumstances to the remaining examined evidence. Even after deciding to exclude the disputed statement, examine what the remaining material establishes.
translations.Himoyasiz bayonot haqidagi rasmiy xabarn: Do not copy an official report about a statement made without defence counsel as a ready-made judgment. Assess the lab’s material and its limitations independently. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Umumiy nazorat va suddagi vazifa: General oversight and the role in court
translations.Prokuratura haqidagi qonunning 2, 4 va 5: Articles 2, 4 and 5 of the Law on the Prosecutor’s Office establish the bodies’ tasks, areas of activity and principles; Article 33 concerns participation in court proceedings. A prosecutor’s specific status in court is determined by the applicable procedural code. Not every request can be turned into a public prosecution.
translations.Murojaatni qabul qilish, huquq buzilishi: Different powers apply to receiving a request, examining a violation of rights and presenting a position in court. Each task identifies both the duty and its legal basis. A complaint about delayed payment is first examined on its own circumstances; its label alone is insufficient.
translations.Har qanday norozilikni jinoyat aybloviga: Do not turn every grievance into a criminal charge. First identify the legal route to which the request belongs. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Iqrorlik va prezumpsiya: Confessions and the presumption of innocence
translations.JPK 112-moddasiga ko‘ra aybga iqrorlik m: Under Article 112 of the Criminal Procedure Code, a confession may serve as a basis for an accusation only if corroborated by the available evidence considered as a whole. Whether the person confesses or denies guilt, their testimony is examined and assessed like other evidence. The presumption under Article 23 of the Criminal Procedure Code and the guarantees of the right to remain silent under Article 28 of the Constitution remain in force.
translations.Iqrorlikni boshqa material bilan tekshir: Study the duty to test a confession against other material. The room illustrates the distinction between an allegation of guilt, examining it and having sufficient grounds for a conclusion. A note stating “raised no objection” does not replace the duty to prove guilt.
translations.Sukut, obro‘ haqidagi gap yoki avvalgi t: Do not use silence, statements about reputation or a previous assumption as independent proof of present guilt. Record the remaining questions clearly. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 81-moddasi dalillarga, 82-moddasi ay: Article 81 of the Criminal Procedure Code concerns evidence; Article 82 concerns circumstances that must be proved for accusation and conviction. Issues such as the incident, the person’s conduct, guilt, consequences and harm must each have an evidentiary basis. Presence at the scene alone does not prove all the necessary elements.
translations.Shaxs, harakat, vaqt, oqibat va aybga do: Compare issues of identity, conduct, time, consequences and guilt with the rule provided. Indicate which circumstance each item of evidence concerns. An entry log provides information that the person was in the building; separate evidence is needed to establish exactly what they took.
translations.Bir shaxs hodisa joyida bo‘lganini ko‘rs: Showing that a person was at the scene does not establish all their actions. Do not substitute another fact for a missing element. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 20-moddasi ish yuritish tiliga, 24-m: Article 20 of the Criminal Procedure Code concerns the language of proceedings, Article 24 the right to a defence, and Articles 46 and 48 the rights of defendants and suspects. Article 51 specifies cases requiring defence counsel’s participation. A signature acknowledging an explanation of rights does not automatically confirm that actual language and defence needs were met.
translations.Maqom, huquq tushuntirilgan vaqt, himoya: Record status, the time rights were explained, defence counsel and language needs in the review table. Link rights issues arising during collection of evidence to its later assessment. The later arrival of defence counsel does not automatically make all the conditions of an earlier interview lawful.
translations.Imzo borligi huquqlar mazmunan ta’minlan: A signature does not automatically prove that rights were effectively ensured. Examine the record together with the actual circumstances. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JK 169-moddasi o‘g‘rilikka, ya’ni o‘zgan: Article 169 of the Criminal Code concerns theft, meaning the secret taking of another person’s property. Finding a phone on a person does not replace examination of every legal element of the conduct. When performing the duties under Article 409 of the Criminal Procedure Code, the prosecutor assesses material both supporting and opposing the charge.
translations.Ishga aloqador materiallarni o‘qing, far: Read the relevant case material, distinguish assumptions from established circumstances, and present a reasoned position. Retain material both supporting and opposing the charge. Finding a similar phone requires a separate check to establish whether it is the missing phone.
translations.Xonani tugatish uchun albatta ayblov huk: Completing the room does not require securing a conviction. The task is to provide a lawful position and reasons consistent with the available material. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 409-moddasi davlat ayblovini quvvatl: Article 409 of the Criminal Procedure Code defines the duties of a prosecutor supporting the public prosecution in examining evidence and asking questions. Each proposition is linked to a necessary circumstance under Article 82 and examination and assessment under Articles 94–95. The number of duplicate documents does not automatically fill the fundamental gap.
translations.Jadvalda har muhim da’vo, tasdiqlovchi m: The table records each important assertion, supporting material, opposing material and open question. The plan for questions and examination in court follows from this table. Money entering an account and who actually controlled that account and for what purpose are separate issues.
translations.Ish papkasidagi hujjat sonini isbotlanga: Do not make the number of documents in a case file a measure of proof. Many duplicate documents cannot fill a fundamental gap. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 90–91-moddalari dalillarni qayd etis: Articles 90–91 of the Criminal Procedure Code concern recording evidence and the role of official records in proof, Article 203 physical evidence, and Articles 204¹–204² digital evidence. Examine the source, collection procedure, copy and integrity. A hash or chain-of-custody table is a learning/technical aid and does not, on its own, prove compliance with every procedural requirement.
translations.Asl material, nusxa va o‘tkazish qaydlar: Compare the original material, copy and transfer records. For a digital file, also record questions about context and integrity. An unchanged file does not answer every question about where and how it was obtained.
translations.Xesh bir xil bo‘lishi barcha protsessual: Matching hashes do not prove compliance with every procedural requirement; nor should the absence of a hash alone be assigned an automatic consequence not stated in the source. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 102-moddasi kutilayotgan javobga bev: Article 102 of the Criminal Procedure Code prohibits questions that directly or indirectly lead towards an expected answer. Also read Articles 441–442 for the procedure for examination in court and Article 409 for the prosecutor’s powers. Exceptions in US cross-examination practice do not automatically apply to proceedings in Uzbekistan.
translations.Avval erkin bayon, so‘ng aniq holat, so‘: Frame questions by moving from a free account to a specific circumstance and then to material showing a contradiction. Also check the rules governing court procedure in the relevant source. Instead of “You saw them at ten o’clock, correct?”, clarify the observation and the source of the time.
translations.Guvohga tayyor javobni tasdiqlatish yoki: Asking a witness to confirm a prepared answer or interrupting them to add an assumption is not a sound method. Do not automatically transfer US cross-examination exceptions to this exercise. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 22 va 95-moddalaridagi xolis tekshir: The requirement for impartial examination in Articles 22 and 95 of the Criminal Procedure Code also means assessing material opposing the charge. Article 409 defines the prosecutor’s duties at trial and requires a position consistent with the examination’s findings. Maintaining an initial view at any cost cannot be a professional objective.
Read the duties in Article 409 of the Criminal Procedure Code. Record which examined information accounts for the difference between the initial and updated positions. If a newly examined record contradicts an earlier proposition, the assessment is updated to reflect the new material.
translations.Oldin bildirilgan fikrni saqlab qolish o: Preserving an earlier opinion is not an end in itself. Merely saying “there is little evidence” is not the same as a reasoned procedural statement. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JK 168-moddasi bo‘yicha aldash yoki isho: Under Article 168 of the Criminal Code, examine the elements of obtaining property or a right to it through deception or abuse of trust. The buyer’s dissatisfaction, payment or delayed delivery cannot substitute for all the elements. Material concerning events and intent is compared chronologically.
Link Article 168 of the Criminal Code to the facts. Analyse material concerning payment, the agreement and conduct in chronological order. Non-delivery of a product does not replace examination of intent and other important circumstances.
translations.Faqat zarar borligi yoki xaridor norozi: Do not assume that all elements of an offence exist solely because there is loss or the buyer is dissatisfied. Addressing an alternative explanation is also part of the task. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JK 27–33-moddalari ishtirokchilik va jin: Read Articles 27–33 of the Criminal Code to distinguish concepts relating to complicity and multiple offences. Assess each person’s conduct, guilt and relevant evidence separately. A conclusion about one person or episode cannot be extended to the others without evidence.
translations.Ishtirokchilik va javobgarlik doirasi ha: Read the rules on complicity and the scope of liability, and create a person–conduct–evidence table. Distinguish common material from material concerning only one person. Two people knowing one another does not prove a third person’s conduct in a particular episode.
translations.Bir epizodning tasdiqlanishini boshqa ep: Do not automatically extend proof of one episode to another. An unproved circumstance cannot be replaced by another fact with a similar label. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 88-moddasi isbotlashda shaxs huquqla: Article 88 of the Criminal Procedure Code concerns protection of individual rights during proof, Article 90 documentation, and Articles 95 and 95¹ assessment and admissibility. Identify the type of defect and its connection to the material. Fabricating a backdated document or concealing a defect is not a lawful way to remedy it.
translations.Qayd, huquqlar va material manbasini sol: Compare the record, rights and the source of the material. Separate admissibility from the sufficiency of other material. A missing signature and a violation of rights require separate analysis under the applicable rules.
translations.Kamchilikni yashirish yoki eski sanada h: Concealing a defect or fabricating a backdated document is not a remedy. Nor should an automatic punishment or consequence absent from the law be invented. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.Ayblov doirasi va o‘zgarishi: Scope and amendment of the charge
translations.JPK 414-moddasi sud muhokamasi doirasini: Article 414 of the Criminal Procedure Code regulates the scope of trial, and Article 415 amendment of the charge by the court. The prosecutor’s position, the right to a defence and the court’s powers are distinct concepts. New information does not confer a right to add a new charge by bypassing procedural requirements.
translations.JPK 409, 414–415-moddalarini birga o‘qib: Read Articles 409 and 414–415 of the Criminal Procedure Code together, and examine the charge’s content, the reason for amendment and the effect on defence rights. In a partially established case, provide a separate answer for each episode. Strong evidence for a second episode cannot fill a gap in the first.
translations.Yangi material chiqqanda protsessual tar: When new material emerges, do not add a new charge by bypassing procedural requirements. Reasoned reassessment is a professional responsibility, not a shortcoming. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JPK 449-moddasi taraflar muzokarasining: Article 449 of the Criminal Procedure Code defines the content and procedure of the parties’ closing arguments, and Article 450 submissions on the substance of the charge. Closing arguments rely on examined material; Article 409 defines the prosecutor’s duties. A demand for a harsher punishment or a powerful voice cannot replace a legal basis.
translations.Nutqni tezis, dalil, qarshi vaj, huquqiy: Review the address for its proposition, evidence, counterargument, legal assessment and requested conclusion. Any view on punishment must rely on the relevant source and circumstances. The assessment concerns the address’s connection to examined circumstances and sources, rather than the severity of its demand.
translations.Qattiqroq talab har doim yuqori mahorat: A harsher demand does not always indicate greater skill. Tone, accent or rapid speech must not be converted into a score for legal correctness. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
translations.JK 70-moddasidagi jazodan ozod qilish oq: Exemption from punishment under Article 70 of the Criminal Code is not the same as an acquittal. Each outcome on separate theft or document-related charges must have its own evidentiary and legal basis. Failure to establish one episode does not automatically mean complete acquittal on all charges.
translations.Qisqa nazariya yangi ma’lumot pozitsiyan: The brief theory section recalls how new information updates a position. Acquittal, a conclusion about conduct and exemption from punishment are different outcomes. Submit the evidentiary and legal basis separately for each episode. Failure to establish one part does not automatically decide another; each requires separate reasons.
translations.Labning muvaffaqiyati ayblov hukmlari so: The lab’s success is not measured by the number of convictions. A lawful and reasoned reassessment of an unestablished part is an essential skill. The learning table, stage button, score and key are not a statutory court procedure or an actual legal outcome.
